headline: UK Weighs Cancelling Rosebank Oilfield Development Amid High Prices
summary: The UK is considering whether to proceed with the £8.7 billion Rosebank oilfield development west of Shetland as global oil prices remain elevated.
why: Decisions on major fossil fuel projects balance energy security and import dependency against climate commitments and capital expenditure.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Scrapping large upstream oil developments could constrain future domestic production capacity.
